CustomField.description: The reference an order carries when no processor issued one - a cheque, or anything else settled outside Stripe. Unique and an external id, so a buyer who submits the same order twice updates one record instead of creating two. This is the ONLY unique key such a transaction has: every Stripe id on it is blank, and without it the duplicate check falls back to contact plus amount plus timestamp, which would silently merge two identical cheques from the same church.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Reference for an order settled outside Stripe. Blank on card and bank payments.
CustomField.label: Manual Reference
